versions.content: If FrNmComUserDataEnabled is set to TRUE and NM-PDU is not configured for triggered transmission in FrIf (FrIfImmediate = TRUE) the FrNm shall collect the NM User Data from the referenced NM I-PDU by calling “PduR_FrNmTriggerTransmit” and combine the user data with the further NM bytes each time before it requests the transmission of the corresponding NM message.
